title: Expert weights held as given, in memory
description: The plain expert_source: each expert's gate/up and down matrices kept as added. Every experts plugin is compared on it, and an engine whose experts fit in memory needs nothing else. Its bundle store (experts:store): open_store(layout, layers, experts, device, path=None) -> device-expert-cache's BundleStore: every expert's bundle (the experts plugin's layout() and pack()) in host memory of its own that the device reads, built by put() and, with a file (`path`, or the store_path option), written there too; a complete file with the same layout is read into that memory without puts (direct reads at a queue depth), and the memory is registered: region() gives the host bytes and a device view a cache fills its slots from, address() a bundle's device address, read() copies bundles out. With kept= (the key of what the bundles hold) the store is kept for the next engine built for the model in the host (the context's keep(): crit serve's model pool, crit eval's process), which gets it back sealed and leaves its closing to the keeper.

store_path.description: the file of the bundle store (built once, reopened while its layout holds); empty: anonymous host memory

csf_scales.description: scale components of the experts plugin's slot layout the store keeps CSF-compressed, with the exception words each bundle holds for each ("gate_up_scale:256,down_scale:128"; ModelOpt's encoding, about half the bytes of E4M3 scales): put() encodes them from the slot-layout bundle or takes the checkpoint's (compressed=), the device expert cache rebuilds the slot layout as it fills slots (no CPU tier over such a store); empty: the slot layout as it is
